scope: Every post-Live filter update on the same admitted physical, bias and sensor histories; startup retains its stricter commissioned residual and temporal contracts.
applies_at: SeaStateFusion_OU_III::update body-frame gyro and specific-force arguments, after application axis mapping, unit conversion and optional calibration
conversion_basis: 2000*pi/180 < 35 rad/s and 16*9.80665 < 160 m/s^2, with margins exceeding binary32 conversion error. Caps are commissioning conditions on actual filter arguments; arbitrary calibration maps are not inferred to preserve them.
shipping_setup: The OU3 AtomS3R sketch uses M5Unified and the mapped/calibrated sample; no range-selection setter is present in that sketch. CI pins M5Unified 0.2.13. The chosen maximum-range envelope does not assert the attached board's register configuration.
